name: SALT SPRAY CHAMBER
desc: Digital Laboratory Salt Spray Corrosion Test Chamber engineered for accelerated corrosion resistance analysis in strict compliance with ASTM B-117. Completely constructed from heavy-duty, anti-corrosive high impact PVC material.
features: Certified full compliance parameters matching international ASTM B-117 protocols
100% Heavy-Duty Anti-Corrosive High-Impact Industrial PVC sheets construction
Heavy moisture saturation operational profile holding ≥ 85% RH
Precision mist regulation holding within 0.5 to 2.0 ml per 80 cm square area per hour
Integrated digital process timer up to 999 hours supporting cyclical atomization

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Digital Laboratory Salt Spray Corrosion Test Chamber
specifications.Primary Testing Function: Accelerated evaluation of anti-corrosion tracking for metals and surface coatings
specifications.Regulatory Standards Compliance: Certified full compliance parameters matching international ASTM B-117 protocols
specifications.Chamber Volumetric Scope: Versatile capacity scale handling standard 108 to 600 Litres load matrices
specifications.Baseline Chamber Working Volume: Optimized standard inner workspace layout sizing at 600 × 450 × 400 mm
specifications.Supported Test Methodologies: Versatile processing modes: Salt Spray (SS), NSS, ASS, and advanced CASS modes
specifications.Chassis Construction Material: 100 percent Heavy-Duty Anti-Corrosive High-Impact Industrial PVC sheets
specifications.Thermal Operating Range: Controlled heating environment working from Ambient up to 60 degrees C
specifications.Temperature Fluctuation Index: Ultra-precise micro-stabilization calibrated at plus or minus 0.5 degrees C
specifications.Thermal Uniformity Factor: Consistent multi-position structural equilibrium within plus or minus 2.0 degrees C
specifications.Chamber Relative Humidity index: Heavy moisture saturation operational profile holding greater than or equal to 85 percent RH
specifications.Salt Mist Atomization Modes: Flexible continuous atomization or programmable cyclical execution paths
specifications.Salt Spray Deposition Rate: Precision mist regulation holding within 0.5 to 2.0 ml per 80 cm square area per hour
specifications.Primary Thermal Tracking Sensor: Industrial-grade high-precision PT100 RTD feedback sensor assembly
specifications.Chamber Clearance Mechanism: Built-in high-efficiency automated internal pneumatic Defog Function
specifications.Process Sequence Controller: Advanced Microprocessor-Based Digital Controller panel interface
specifications.Integrated Process Timer: Precise digital tracking clock programmable from 0 to 999 Hours maximum
specifications.Electrical Power Options: Standard Single Phase 220V 50Hz line or Industrial Three Phase 380V 50Hz line
specifications.Target Field Applications: Metallurgical Quality Control, Automotive Finishing, Electronics, and Coating Labs
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive On-site Manufacturer Warranty on core heating and atomizers
